olivia_ux: Quick heads-up — after bringing up q6b-int4 in staging we're seeing a ~4% drop on the longform summarization benchmark versus q6b-fp16 baseline. Looks like tokenization boundaries changed for long inputs and dedupe is leaking golden variants into holdouts. Posting two failing examples below.

olivia_ux: example A input: (truncated) '...annual shareholder meeting minutes — action items and financial summary...', baseline summary ok, q6b-int4 output is missing the bullet list.

olivia_ux: example B input: 'Customer support thread: multiple threads merged', q6b-int4 hallucinates a meeting note.

olivia_ux: Anyone seen tokenizer/token-split drift after the quant stack changes?

mike_ml: I noticed token split shifts when I swapped the tokenizer vocab merge table for the int4 build. Perplexity spikes on >1k tokens. Ran a quick diff: `python tools/token_debug.py --model q6b-int4 --sample <id>` shows extra `<unk>`-like splits on multiword tokens.

mike_ml: command I used: `scripts/eval_token_splits.sh q6b-int4 --samples 200 --out /tmp/q6b-splits.csv`

dina_labelops: Can you paste the sample ids for the failing cases? We can run a micro-golden refresh and re-label the affected holdout subset (longsumm category). How many unique holdout items hit?

olivia_ux: small list for triage: 483921, 483957, 483999, 484120, 484245. Fetch query I ran:
```
SELECT id, text_len, tag FROM promptset
WHERE tag IN ('longsumm','support-thread')
AND created_at > '2025-09-01'
ORDER BY text_len DESC
LIMIT 500;
```

kevin_infra: FYI deploy-bot flagged the q6b-int4 staging rollout earlier (canary group). Suggest pinning traffic to q6b-fp16 for production and adding a temporary routing rule: len>1024 -> baseline. We can do that with the routing policy in console.

deploy-bot: [system] Deployed q6b-int4 to staging cluster 'staging-us-west-2' at 2025-10-14T15:12:07Z. Canary traffic: 5% -> 20% (automated ramp). No errors flagged by infra but perf variance + tail latency + tokenization diffs reported by eng-ml.

mike_ml: Proposed eval plan: run A/B on a 1k stratified holdout (by length and intent) comparing q6b-fp16 vs q6b-int4+new-tokenizer. Script snippet:
```
python eval/ab_compare.py --models q6b-fp16,q6b-int4 --holdout sampled_1k.json --metrics rouge,exact_match,halluc_rate
```
We should also instrument pre-tokenization fingerprint to detect dedupe leakage.

dina_labelops: We can ingest 200 highest-impact failures into a micro-golden job. ETA: start tomorrow morning, finish labels by EOD tomorrow if nothing blocks. Prioritize categories: longsumm > support-thread > technical-docs.

olivia_ux: thanks — please also run a dedupe pre-tokenization checksum on the holdout before labeling. Example helper: `sha256(text.encode('utf-8'))` + normalize whitespace/token boundaries. If fingerprints match existing gold, exclude from relabel.

mike_ml: Also recommending fallback policy: if request.tokens > 1024 OR model returns <confidence 0.6, route to q6b-fp16 for that request. Should reduce visible regressions quickly without rollback.

olivia_ux: Agreed. Next actions: 1) @dina_labelops kick off 200 micro-golden tomorrow 2) @mike_ml run the 1k A/B and share metrics by EOD 3) @kevin_infra add len>1024 routing rule in staging and prod pin until we confirm. I'll open a ticket and attach the failing examples + eval plan.

kevin_infra: I'll create the routing change as a feature flag so we can toggle quickly.

dina_labelops: Ack — will post progress updates in this thread and link the labeling job when it's live.

olivia_ux: Perfect, thanks team :thumbsup:
